Process

Simple, but not instant.

The service is designed to feel like a client process, not a checkout funnel. You place an order, submit credentials through the portal, then the account moves through verification, queue allocation, trading, and return.

01

Place the evaluation order

Choose the account size and pay the flat handling fee. The prop firm challenge itself is purchased separately by you.

02

Submit platform access

Use the client portal to submit the firm, login, platform, notes, and any unusual rule details. Credentials are stored encrypted in this demo flow.

03

Track the account

The account moves through queue allocation, risk review, session pacing, consistency review, and completion. You can check status any time.

Operator note: around CPI, NFP, and FOMC sessions, timelines can extend. Some firms require slower pacing depending on trailing drawdown and consistency rules.

Credential handling

Before you ask about logins.

No banking access

We never request withdrawal details, payout settings, or banking information. Only the evaluation platform login is needed.

Encrypted submission

Credential submissions are stored in the local demo database. In production this must be connected to a proper encrypted backend.

Reset after return

Once the account is returned, reset the password with the prop firm. It is the cleanest handover process.

FAQ

Common questions

Is this affiliated with MFFU, Apex, Lucid Trading, or any prop firm?+
No. EvalPro is independent. You buy the evaluation from the prop firm yourself; this service handles the evaluation process after that.
How long does it usually take?+
Most evaluations complete in 7–14 trading days. It varies by firm rules, minimum trading days, market conditions, and queue status.
Can I update credentials later?+
Yes. In the portal, open the evaluation and submit updated credentials. Admin will see the update in the operations queue.
Where do I get support?+
Use the client portal or join the Discord support hub: https://discord.gg/AsqMASKj
